name: Mango Masala
why_it_matters: Family-run multi-section restaurant on Kacheri Road, operating in Ajmer since 1998 — multiple themed sections (Mango Masala, Mango Curry, Moussaka Terrace, CoffoHolic, kids' play area) under one roof. Mango Curry is the non-veg wing where laal maas is the order.
insider_tip: Mango Curry (the non-veg section) is run separately from the main pure-veg dining hall — ask at the entrance which side seats faster.
signature_address: Kacheri Road, India Motor Circle, Hathi Bhata, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305001

name: Rasoi - The Train Restaurant
why_it_matters: Pure-veg family restaurant operating since 2001 with a quirky train-themed dining section and a fine-dining floor with revolving tables — Ajmer's most kid-recognisable veg sit-down. Located near Ana Sagar Lake.
insider_tip: Ask for the train-coach seating downstairs if you have kids — it's the actual reason locals bring out-of-town families here.
signature_address: 3rd Floor, Swami Complex, Sardar Patel Marg, Hathi Bhata, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305001

name: Ambrosia Restaurant
why_it_matters: Rooftop restaurant at Nagina Bagh on Lohagal Road, ranked #5 of 176 Ajmer restaurants on TripAdvisor — terrace looks out at the Aravalli range. Known for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian preparations of regional cuisine.
insider_tip: Late lunch (2-4 pm) gets the cleanest Aravalli views before the haze rises — better than dinner if you want the actual hill backdrop.
signature_address: Nagina Bagh, Lohagal Road, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305004
